governing_outcome: Reduce repeated user-detected drift by making native UAOS activation more reliable, making systemic repair completeness mechanically observable, and making promotion converge under frozen included/free-first verification without creating another cognition/evolution controller or claiming native ChatGPT physical complete mediation.
observations: Current canonical cognition already states that user/model/expert framing is evidence rather than causal authority, so duplicating that algorithm in Custom Instructions or a Skill would create a shadow authority rather than fix the executable closure gap.

Native ChatGPT has no verified repository-controlled pre-send/pre-tool hook; activation can be improved behaviorally through a compact Custom Instructions handoff plus an installable non-authoritative Skill dispatcher, but physical complete mediation cannot be claimed.

Before this intervention, ProblemClosureSignals could verify a selected repair without explicit failure-class scope, owning-abstraction, adjacent-path, duplicate/superseded mechanism, generalization or recurrence evidence.

Before this intervention, ChangeProposal/EvaluationResult had required scenarios and acceptance checks but did not bind frozen required acceptance checks, verification-round budget, paid-review budget or blocking/non-blocking finding disposition into assess_promotion.

Use a non-authoritative Skill plus compact Custom Instructions only for activation; keep cognition/closure/evolution owned by canonical repository mechanisms; extend existing closure and promotion gates mechanically.
